r2.role: Sr Software Engineer / Front End Architect
r2.summary: Design of highly scalable frontend architectures and distributed systems for mission-critical applications, with a focus on SSR, React, and third-party platform integrations.
r2.description:
Frontend architecture and development in a high-growth environment.

- Design and implementation of scalable frontend architectures using React and Server-Side Rendering (SSR), strategically selecting the right tools based on the problem to solve.
- Development and maintenance of APIs to integrate with backend systems and third-party platforms.
- Implementation of distributed architecture patterns to improve scalability, fault tolerance, and system flexibility.
- Integration of frontend features into mission-critical applications with tight deadlines.
- Contribution to company-wide technical standards and reliability improvements.
- Promotion of a zero-bug quality culture through strong engineering practices.
- Security-first mindset applied across all technical decisions.
- Technical mentorship and promotion of a culture of learning, growth, and accountability within the team.
- Cross-team collaboration to build internal tools that improve overall productivity.

santanderTecnologiaArgentina_2.summary: Banking application for corporate clients focused on electronic check management, built with React and a micro-frontend architecture.
santanderTecnologiaArgentina_2.description:
ECHEQ Project.

- Implementation of a micro-frontend architecture to decouple functionalities and improve scalability and maintainability.
- Concurrent work on more than 10 projects using React and TypeScript.
- Use of Redux, Styled Components, and the bank’s internal UX libraries.
- Integration with CI/CD pipelines (Dumbo) and code quality control through SonarQube.
- Collaboration with mobile teams, applying adjustments to the Android application (Kotlin) derived from changes in the web platform.

santanderTecnologiaArgentina_1.description:
CLOUDCHEQ Project.
